output.reason: The linked issue [ev-82d53c4df567][ev-99f9ffd24ae6] says who is exposed: setups where ARGOCD_APPLICATIONSET_CONTROLLER_NAMESPACES limits the ApplicationSet controller to certain namespaces. Its example is several cluster-wide Argo CD instances in one cluster, each given namespaces that don't overlap, where every instance still tried to reconcile the same ApplicationSet. The PR [ev-e3ce74873951] states the change: namespace filtering now also applies to Update, Delete and Generic events, and [ev-4fc8c5483f30] shows it lives in applicationset_controller.go. Together with the release note [ev-bec5d8a63f4d], this gives the subject, the change, and an applicability condition based on the namespaces setting being configured, so an engineer could write the open applicability aspect.
